summary: Regression testing of New-Patient Identity Duplicate Prevention layer (backend + frontend). Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_identity_dup_prevention.py covering 9 scenarios on synthetic data (syn-*). Backend 8/8 pass + 1 regression skip auto-recovered via manual curl. Frontend UI confirmed: Pending tab has NO verify-approve, shows verify-review-link + verify-blocked-note for review-required rows, verify-as-new opens confirm-new-patient-dialog with cancel/accept. Recently Verified shows history-identity-LINKED_EXISTING badge with canonical directory name 'SYNTHETIC ALPHAVILLE, Test Alpha' + NEW_PATIENT for pat_C. Patient Search 'synth' collapses linked portal+directory into ONE row (PIN 9901) + shows the other 3 synthetic patients once each. Visit audit regression GET /api/internal/audit/visit/{id} => 200 verified via physician PAGUAYO.

ui_bugs.issue: Linked directory row 'SYNTHETIC ALPHAVILLE, Test Alpha' (PIN 9901, has portal_linked=true in backend) still shows the badge 'NO PORTAL ACCOUNT' instead of indicating that an active portal account is linked. Does not block the collapse logic but is misleading.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Fix 'NO PORTAL ACCOUNT' label on Patients search rows that are collapsed with an active linked portal account (portal_linked=true).
critical_code_review_comments: verifications_history() filter requires both verification_status in [verified,rejected] AND verified_at exists; make sure every verify path (link + verify, verify-as-new) sets verified_at — synthetic pat_D1 seeded with status=verified but verified_at=None is correctly excluded.

Verifications.jsx: history-identity-* testid is generated from the state string returned by backend (LINKED_EXISTING / NEW_PATIENT / IDENTITY_REVIEW). Keep these state values stable to avoid breaking test selectors.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 identity dup tests + visit audit regression 200)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of asserted UI contract (verify-approve absent, review-link + blocked-note + verify-as-new + confirm dialog present; LINKED_EXISTING badge present; Patients search collapses to one row)
